Hello, this is EliosVR.

The official forum releases are as follows:



[h3]Changed[/h3]
1. Fixed the phenomenon that the phrase "Level Up" is only visible in one direction

2. Teleport travel distance adjustment (reduction)

3. Monster bug fixes
-Fixed some monsters not being attacked or damaged by monsters

4. Edit store page content
-Change the play space size



[h3]Bug related inquiries[/h3]
1. Infinite loading (infinite loading after selecting a character)
    -As a solution to this problem, if you have modified it to log in again but still can't access it, we need your information to fix it. Please send screenshots, PC specs and VR device information to info@fingereyes.com for improvement.
